entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The present application under Section 439 seeks following prayer:-
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that the petitioner/accused may kindly be admitted to interim bail for conduction of surgery of the applicant for a period for 30 days in FIR no. 62/2019 P.S. Sadar Bazar U/s 354 /376 /506 IPC and Sec. 4 & 8 POCSO Act on furnishing the Surety/Personal Bond to the satisfaction of this Hon'ble Court, in the interest of justice."
2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant seeks leave to withdraw the present application.
3. Leave granted.
4.
The present application is dismissed as withdrawn and disposed of accordingly.
5. Pending application(s), if any, also stand disposed of.
